capabilities.capability: Web Development - Fast, flexible scripting for dynamic websites and web applications
Database Connectivity - Native support for multiple database systems (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, etc.)
Session Management - Built-in cookie and session handling
File Handling - File upload, remote file operations, and file system access
Security - HTTP authentication, cryptography extensions, and encryption capabilities
API Development - RESTful API creation and web services integration
Image Processing - Image manipulation and generation capabilities
Email Functionality - Mail sending and handling
Command-line Usage - CLI scripting and automation
